items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Now you know a guy who's doing well and he plays trumpet and sings Kermit Ruffin. Right. Yeah, Kermit does the same thing.

ctx.x: I find out that you can go bigger when you sing. I like on Burmese Street where I work now. I mean, I sing.

That's true. I mean, I sing. That's true. I think. I'm like, I should have started singing a long time ago. Now you know a guy who's doing well and he plays trumpet and sings Kermit Ruffin. Right. Yeah, Kermit does the same thing. Now, Wynton is one of the greatest trumpet players I've ever heard, but he doesn't sing.
